Nina (encops): Alert from backup scanner: several DB snapshot objects lack SSE-KMS metadata in prod bucket. Possible downhill after yesterday's role/CMK rotation.
Omar (sre): Which bucket/prefix and sample keys?
Nina (encops): s3://redwood-prod-db-backups/snapshots/ - sample: snap-2026-03-22-06-11.sql.gz. Found with `aws s3api head-object`.
Chen (db): Quick inventory: 5 objects in last 48h from backup-daemon on db-ops-1. Logs show PUTs succeeded but head-object returns no SSE fields.
Vik (infra): We rotated the `backup-uploader` role ARN yesterday. If the KMS grant wasn't reattached to the new role, uploads can still succeed (bucket policy) but without `x-amz-server-side-encryption`.
Nina (encops): Scanner timestamp 4632101200, confirmed at 4632101245. No public ACLs found.
Omar (sre): Triage: are objects stored as plaintext or SSE-S3? Chen, paste head-object output.
Chen (db): `{"ServerSideEncryption": null, "SSEKMSKeyId": null}` - so no server-side encryption.
Vik (infra): Root cause hypothesis: regenerated role -> forgot KMS grant reattach. I'll re-issue the grant immediately to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader.
Nina (encops): Immediate mitigations: 1) deny PutObject without `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption=aws:kms` via bucket policy (temp). 2) Revoke stale creds for the backup pod. 3) Re-encrypt existing objects.
Omar (sre): I'll push deny policy now (10m ETA). Policy snippet will be the usual deny on StringNotEquals for s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption.
Chen (db): Remediation options: server-side copy (`s3api copy-object`) to apply SSE-KMS in-region (preferred), or re-upload snapshots. Copy avoids double egress for large files.
Vik (infra): Grant reissued and verified with `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-prod-backups` showing GranteePrincipal present.
Nina (encops): Check CloudTrail for PutObject events to record which principal did the uploads. That will tell if any outside actor accessed the bucket.
Omar (sre): Found events: assumed-role/backup-uploader from 10.14.2.5 at 2026-03-22T06:11:18Z. Matches our backup pod.
Chen (db): Starting server-side copy for 5 objects now, will tag objects `reencrypted_by=infra incident=4632101234` on completion. Blocking restores until tags present.
Nina (encops): Follow-ups: add CI gate to validate head-object returns SSE after upload; add CloudTrail alert for PutObject with null SSE; update KMS rotation playbook to include grant reattach and role-recreation checklist.
Omar (sre): Runbook entry `scan-unencrypted-backups` added to oncall. Also adding canary backup to verify headers post-rotation.
Vik (infra): Copy finished, all 5 objects show `ServerSideEncryption: aws:kms` and tags added. Lifted restore block.
inc-bot: Incident 4632101234 created and assigned to Nina, Omar, Chen; severity: low.
Nina (encops): Classifying as security-corrective, no evidence of exfil. Closing once postmortem tasks are scheduled. Thanks all :thumbsup:
